item.title: Random Access Memory
item.description: A usb flash drive seeking out data
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: SCP Article

Elevator Pitch: A USB flash drive that teleports from one data storage device to another

Central Narrative: A usb stick jumps from storage device to storage device to download random files. The usb stick starts out first with things like computers and servers, but changes to more forms of data storage, such as phones, alarm clocks, vending machines, electronic locks, and eventually brains. As it jumps from device to device, it attaches itself to anything that would contain data rather than to a port. This causes problems as, when it jumps, it will deform anything around it in order to fit into the device. This might mean cracking a casing or pushing away brain tissue. The usb stick was first found by an on-site tech repair team while examining a broken computer. Initially, it is relatively easy to contain by putting it into a secure storage locker, as it so far has only chosen computers. Containment becomes more complicated as it begins to attach itself to the electronic locks, cameras, and even occasionally other scps. Containment becomes vital when the usb begins to cause fatalities by inserting itself into brains. Eventually the containment consists of an empty room with one DC voltage light and a mechanical locked door with a viewing port and a telescope. New usbs with random data are pulled in via a pulley system using only rope and a hand crank. The nearest telephone is a rotary phone with no data storage whatsoever. Due to its lethality, researchers weren’t able to come up with an explanation as to what the USB’s function is, or where it came from.

**Additional Notes:* I don't know if i should add more detail to the over all story on this post. It would mostly be the foundation slowly losing control over the scp until the end.

item.title: Revised: Thaumiel Factory Failure (seeking greenlight)
item.description: A factory that has been build by an individual to produce Thaumiul anomalies and sell those to the foundation in hopes of extreme profit.
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: SCP Article

Genre (Optional): Comedy, Emotional (might be just an emotional piece)

Elevator Pitch: An email/fax is send to many foundation employees, including the O5-council that says that someone has failed in delivering the promised products and that they cant manufacture them any longer. Attached is a business card with the information of where this SCP is and the testing and containment ensues.

Central Narrative: "Our business relationship has to come to an abruptive end before it even really began. I have no more funds and everything i try ends up in utter failure. It has been a pleasure working alongside you." is the email many high ranked SCP foundation personnel receive one day. Attached to it are the credentials of a business that went bankrupt a month ago. This SCP is located on an untouched coal reserve that has been bought by a coal mining company. The SCP is a factory which is supposed to create thaumiel SCPs and then sell them to the foundation with huge profit. This SCP is supposed to tell the story of how one individual tried bulding up a business with this idea and how this coal company ruined them by denying them access to much needed ressources because they want coal. All testing is halted until the mysterious individual is found. Will be found eventually (alive and somewhat well). Also includes testing logs of all different kinds of prototypes this SCP made.

Hook/Attention-Grabber: A story of medium length of how a SCP got made without malicious intent, made to aid the foundation. Also includes testing logs.

Additional Notes: I m not sure if this SCP is supposed to end on a happy or on a sad note ( i want it to end happy because that rarely happens in SCP articles and i think happy endings are needed sometime). The individual who made this SCP gets employed by the foundation to improve this SCP. Researchers might get frustrated with how little progress they make, even though the original creator is helping. Might leave that last part out though.

item.title: (Awaiting greenlight) The Shape-shifting toy
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: SCP Article

Genre (Optional): Horror.

Page Layout (Optional): I plan to explain about the SCP through Addendums incidents logs and autopsy's this will reveal to to the reader what the SCP can do, the affects of it's powers, and it's origin.

Elevator Pitch: The SCP is a spirit that haunts a abandoned factory. It takes form of diffrent toys that the factory used to make but only the toys. The SCP has pshycic that affect anyone in a 500 meter distance. It kills humans with what looks like a tongue and leaves a brown goo after doing so. In the article researchers are trying to find it's origins and more of it's abilities.

Central Narrative: The SCP is found in an abandoned factory in a city in israel. it was due to be destroyed but before being destroyed construction workers were told to inspect the area before demolition. once they entered and saw the spirit SCP one of them decided to take a look. The SCP slashed one of the workers the other one managed to escape. After that incident the foundation was alerted and bought the factory. It set up a site to contain the spirit SCP which could not be moved from the factory. an interview was conducted with the surviving worker after the interview he was given amnestics. an autopsy was conducted and a brown goo-ish material was left behind test results show it is unknown to the foundation yet but it melts all organs. But not bones. In the article the previous incident and test incidents will be inside the article explaining further about the SCP

Hook/Attention-Grabber: The attention-grabber here is the spirit SCP. Due to it's unique abilities readers would get interested and read more. For example: The spirit SCP has pshycic powers in a 500 meter radius. In the article affects of long exposure to these pshycic powers will be explained through incidents and addendums. It's ability to slash humans in half perfectly will also be tested in the article, as well as the goo it leaves behind. It's mystery and discovery will encourage readers to continue to read.

Additional Notes: If my idea gets accepted i will add more to the SCP. It's origins, and solving most of the mysteries still around it. And again this is just an idea not a full SCP. Thanks for reading

item.title: Laugh Track 1952
item.description: An old laugh track used in old television shows that laughs at people (more to read)
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: SCP Article

Genre: Unsure

Elevator Pitch: What if you lived life in a reality show? Then use Laugh Track 1952, you'll LOVE it.

Central Narrative: The laugh track, used in old television shows, was created in 1936 and was dismissed in 1952 because of lashback from the public. Now, contained in Site-822, the laugh track is responsible for atleast two (2) deaths of Class-D a year. Here's how it works; A subject presses the button on top of the box, and it plays one out of four laugh tracks (SCP-XXXX-1, through SCP-XXXX-4). Once the subject has listened to the laugh track, they will start to fade out of consciousness and faint. Once awake, the laugh track will link itself into the brain for as long as the subject is alive.

Every once in a while, the laugh track (1-4) will go off, similar to that of a reality show. This makes the subjects life a literal reality show.

Hook/Attention-Grabber: If you like reality shows, you'll like this, that's about it.

item.title: concept idea!
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: yes

Page Type: SCP Article

Genre (Optional): Action/History

Page Layout (Optional): Basic format containment then background of SCP

Elevator Pitch: An SCP item that gives the wearer invincibility inhumane strength and expansive knowledge of combat and war strategy. It comes in the form of a suit of spartan armor that will transform into whatever armor the wearer knows of.

Central Narrative: The armor was discovered during the Vietnam war and captured by the Foundation they then found through testing and a few containment incidents the basic abilities of the armor as well as learning with untrained individuals it will cause them to enter a blood rage upon putting it on and it will deteriorate their body killing them within hours of exposure. With individuals trained extensively in combat the blood rage will not take hold unless under extreme emotional or physical stress and the armor will deteriorate much slowly causing death much later (possibly years) than other subjects. The armor is permitted to be used in world ending situations and large site containment breaches. The armor also has access to famous warrior throughout history and the deterioration seen in subjects is most likely due to this effect as the armor will steal and contain your spirit. It also has a calling effect that pulls nearby personnel into attempting to wear it resulting in their deaths. The armor was originally created during the Battle of Thermopylae when a Persian soldier donned the armor of Leonidas causing his spirit to put a curse on the armor (causing the effects seen today).

Hook/Attention-Grabber: This SCP is a tool the Foundation can use to combat many of the threats the Foundation faces however it is a very unstable tool and finding a suitable subject is incredibly difficult as most will die within hours, also it creates an effect similar to the "One Ring" from Lord of the Rings in which it pulls people towards it and typically has them fight over the owner of the armor which is very dangerous as many valuable Foundation assets could be drawn to it and die to the wearer. Also the amount of knowledge the armor holds from its past users could prove useful to the Foundation as well as its extensive knowledge of strategy.

Additional Notes: I feel as if I am missing something to make this story truly unique and I hope someone can take notes on this and help me figure out how to properly narrow down my ideas or give it an extra hook of some sort.

item.title: Dr.Agent Blue and the curse of Site 1xx
item.description: wanting to start writing on SCP site
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: SCP Tale

Genre (Optional): intent to be adventure series

Central Narrative:Dr.Agent Blue was given orders for his new assignment, but when he is out of his prime universe he helps those in need rather than be an observer.

Additional Notes:
This is the anomaly that Site 1xx is currently built under

This anomaly is a used car lot that has different cars, outdoor decorations and address plaque contrary to its location every week on sunday morning when the sales people have a day off.

The building stays the same, but everything else about the used car lot changes and the employees had no idea, they thought the supplier changed out the entire stock and replaced paperwork every sunday.

The name of the business is Roulette Auto, ironically with good reason. When the foundation was investigating this for anomalous properties, it was orginally theorized it was a result of teleportation to different car lot in the world or time travel with a twenty five year window into the past. After several tests.A single D-class was told to stay in the lot when it changed with a tracking device and if it was a result of time travel to seek out the interaction of the foundation. The tracking device was not found and the foundation has no records of the D-class in historical archives. Being sent into the future was not ruled out yet.

The experiment was tryed 3 more times with no results.

The original D-class was recovered exactly years later with a tale of visiting 102 different worlds with various inconsistencies to our own.
Dr. Agent Blue is to be given command over Site 1XX for his years loyalty with the foundation by 05 council with top secret authority and classified authorized information. Site 1XX is need to know and information has to be given directly by 05 and multiversal departments.

[c]Orders are to find and map parallel worlds and gather database files of alternate foundations by any means using classified credentials. Members of site 1XX are not to intervene in any matters other than those of the prime world.

[c] Members of Site 1XX are to not interact with at all costs any interaction of SCP 507, if an SCP 507 is to be on premises of Site 1XX for any reason, the SCP 507 is to be removed from the two acre car lot by any means. The interaction between an SCP 507 and the unlisted SCP known at Site 1XX is theoretically catastrophic for the multiverse.

item.title: My SCP Idea
item.description: I need help in finding out if my SCP idea is original or good enough that I should go ahead with it.
item.content:encoded:
So basically, my SCP is a Euclid class anomaly which is a muddy puddle. it's sort of like a cave system full of mud with a huge internal area. The trick is, every day, a few mud creatures come out of the hole and are aggressive to anyone that is nearby. They usually try to suffocate this person or in rare cases assimilate the person into themselves. Because of this danger, the SCP Foundation have set up a secure area around the SCP and armed MTF soldiers with incendiary devices (one of the only known weaknesses).
Usually 2-3 monsters come out of the puddle a day, but in rainy/stormy weather, that number can be boosted to 10-30 monsters. That's why they keep meteorological scientists and researchers on-site.

So, is my plot unique? Is it boring? If it hasn't been done before, how can I improve on it?

Thank you.

item.title: Temporal Hula Hoops.
item.description: When an object passes through the hoop it is transported 10 minutes into the past or the future, depending on which side you go through.
item.content:encoded:
It is just a thing that does a thing, but I feel it's simple enough for it to be worthy of the site if nothing similar has been done before, the containment and testing logs will probably be more interesting than one may expect, for example, the hoop must be left idle for 10 minutes before and after testing due to the possibility of a D-Class using it to breach containment via going back in time to the point where the hoop is being transported to the testing room.

I also want to clarify that it isn't proper time travel, it works by transporting objects to an alternate dimension that was created exactly 10 minutes before or after the one you're currently in, with no other differences, I feel that this is a good way to get around the whole tricky paradox discussion.

I'm also considering having multiple hoops, having them test out what happens when you put a hoop into another hoop and then go through it, in a case like this the destination of the hoop inside the hoop will just be where it was 10 minutes ago from its perspective, consider the following test, at 0 minutes hoop A is introduced to the testing area, at 5 minutes hoop B2 exits hoop A (arriving from the future), hoop B2's destination will therefore be 10 minutes into the test (if going through it towards the past), an object A is put through hoop B2, then at 10 minutes into the test Hoop B1 is introduced into the testing area, object A instantly exits hoop B1 (arriving from the "future" from the hoops perspective, the past from an outside observers perspective.), at 15 minutes Hoop B1 is thrown through Hoop A, it's destination being at 5 minutes into the test, this concludes the test.

This is just what I had been considering while thinking of this idea, I think it's interesting enough to not simply be a "thing that does a thing" but others may not share the same opinion, what do you think?

item.title: (Seeking Greenlight) Host of the Eldritch Abomination
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights:** Yes.

Page Type: SCP Article

Genre: Horror/Comedy

Elevator Pitch: If any of you ever know about eldritch abominations, then imagine what happens when a human embodies themselves with the physiology of eldritch abominations.

Central Narrative:

+ show block
– hide block

This SCP is a humanoid male that embodied the physiology of eldritch abominations, which after he discovers a strange glowing black stone that has exploded inside of a meteor landed nearby the area where he was taking a piss. A few days later, there were reports of peoples going missing on the campsite, and some injured survivors, as they claimed that a monster had attacked them following their describing of it, its like a human, at the same time like a monster. When this was heard, the Foundation knew they have an anomaly, as they dispatched a group of MTF to track down it in the woods. The MTF detained it when they witness it transforming back to a normal human after consuming five camping inviduals. The Foundation lied about the missing individuals and blamed them for being attacked by wild animals in the woods.

During the interview session between the host and a researcher, the host stated that every 5 hours passed without consuming any nutrition, the eldritch being would apparently take over their body. However, they also explained that the eldritch could speak, as another interview session was conducted after five hours has passed by. The Foundation decided that every 5 hours passed by, the entity would receive some food like steak, hamburgers, and sometimes pizzas, as for other "food" would be D-Class personnel for testings.


Hook/Attention-Grabber: This SCP is inspired by Venom of Marvel. The host of this SCP is a high-school friend of SCP-105.

item.title: SCP Idea - Laptop with the ability of abduction
item.description: A brand less laptop that has the ability to abduct victims and can abduct them into its videos.
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: SCP Article

Genre (Optional): Mystery

Elevator Pitch: A brand less laptop is discovered in a suburban home that has the ability to abduct people after certain requirements are met. The victims who complete these requirements are then abducted by the laptop and is transported into a video where they are essentially trapped for life.

Central Narrative: The brand less laptop has a shrouded origin and has a supernatural ability of abducting people when they meet specific requirements. The requirements include appearing in front of the in-built camera of the laptop and watching at least 1 video on a website that the laptop is displays at all times. The website can not be closed or minimized. Victims who are abducted by the laptop are placed within a video where the victim is placed in a black room with a singular light that illuminates their crying eyes. The victims cannot escape and the Foundation is unable to rescue them.

Hook/Attention-Grabber: The main hook is that the people who are abducted are neither confirmed to be dead or alive. There is no clear indication in the videos that the victims die and there is only a single scene in the last 3 seconds of the video that show the victims in extreme pain.

Additional Notes: I'm still writing the article. Any feedback would be greatly appreciated on this idea.

item.title: Strict Stethoscope
item.description: A stethoscope that can detect medical maladies and hates prescription drug abuse
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: SCP Article

Elevator Pitch: A sentient stethoscope capable of speech, with extensive knowledge of non-anomalous medical ailments, and human anatomy. The anomaly can accurately diagnose patients by sight alone, even if the affliction isn’t currently visible When an individual attempts to take any prescription medication that they are not currently prescribed, they will be compelled not to the first time, and the stethoscope will angrily inform them about the dangers of taking unprescribed medicine, and warn them not to. If the individual decides to take it anyway, they will gain a severe and often outlandish form of whatever ailment the medication treats. If they choose not to, a non-anomalous lollipop will materialize near the subject.

Central Narrative: The item is recovered from an otherwise normal hospital after reports from a nurse who attempted to abuse opiates while hiding in a storage closet. During recovery, the anomaly cries out in protest and then refuses to communicate until a researcher threatens to take Adderal during an interview. After learning they are conversing with a doctor, the anomaly opens up, detailing its creation. The item promises full cooperation so long as they are allowed to practice medicine or be in the vicinity of a clinic, as that is their sole purpose for existence. After being asked if they have ever signed a Hippocratic Oath, the item replies that they find it nonsensical, and instead signed an Oath of their own design, that allows them to punish patients for “failure to follow basic instructions or general stupidity,” among other things. A selection from the oath is engraved into the side of the anomaly, and a full paper copy is retrieved from the location the anomaly states it was created in. Several tests follow, wherein the item diagnoses several subjects with near-perfect success, and punishes subjects with effects that reciprocate the medications they take. After being presented with an individual afflicted by another SCP, the item expresses confusion, and is unable to diagnose, or offer any treatment. After proving itself, the item is transferred to Site 20 to aid in medical duties.

Hook/Attention-Grabber: The secondary anomalous effects are dark, with a small hint of humor. I thought it’d be neat.

Additional Notes: None

item.title: SCP-ARK
item.description: A short, life bringing SCP, slightly related to other biblical SCP's.
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: SCP Article

Genre (Optional): (Other: slightly creepy)

Page Layout (Optional): Containment, Description, and then hints at what the greater picture is via an incident

Elevator Pitch: An SCP that bring life via anomalous means, and has ties to the biblical SCP's such as Dr. Clef's Proposal, and 4840

Central Narrative: In simple term's: its Noah's ark, with that SCP twist to it. The ark is buried underneath a mountain, now making it a 'man made cavern'. This cavern is constantly dripping water via anomalous means, and once a day, a drop of water turns to blood, and replicates until it turns into two full specimens of a normal animal species: one male and one female. Originally the foundation was fine with discretely relocating the animals to a natural habitat, until during a surgical inspection one started speaking, talking of biblical anomalies and telling the foundation they should just let the cavern make life. It tells them that after a catastrophe this was chosen as “life’s safe haven”, and itd be better to stay that way in the event another cataclysm occurs. After this, the foundation started killing all the new specimens, in fear all of them are unnoticeably anomalous.

Hook/Attention-Grabber: It's short, sweet, and too the point. It tells the story and leaves the mystery. Think of it like a different take on SCP-2000: an anomaly that (for the most part) creates normal life, but the foundation decides to contain it as they understand it even less.

item.title: SCP Idea: Curse of the Pharaoh
item.description: Combine the Curse of the Pharaoh with a story about an ancient Sarkic betrayal.
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: SCP Article

Genre (Optional): Horror, Emotional

Elevator Pitch:
- explain the widely known concept of the "curse of the pharaoh" as well as the real-world constraints on visits to the grave sites in-universe
- I refer to the common assumption that the curse (which manifests in increasingly deadly symptoms of illness) was cast by the pharaohs but then quickly reveal that is actually caused by an anomaly beneath the pharaohnic graves and the other version is misinformation.
- The anomaly is a circular deposit of sand covered in a network of necrotic tissue and metal converging into two humanoid figures that embrace each other, one from flesh, one from metal.
- I then describe a text scroll found at the figurines and an excerpt from sarkic scripture that the Foundation linked to the historical site.

Central Narrative:
The scroll found at the figures is a letter from a sarkic Karcist to Klavigar Nadox seeking advice. The Karcist describes a battle fought at the site of the SCP agains the Mekhanites that was won by the Sarkics. After the battle, the Karcist found a Mekhanite machine imbued with a spirit (I don't go on about what that is, because the Karcist cant know that. But I have an idea about it). The Karcist describes their deap affection to the spirit and how it kept the machine with it after the battle. However the Karcist now fears for their life, as the Sarkic community frowns upon a Mekhanite anomaly.

+ show block
– hide block

The second text is an excerpt from sarkic scripture also recounting the battle at the site, talking about a Betrayer-Karcist that tried to poison the minds of the sarkic community with Mekhanite tech. It then describes how they tried to stop the Karcist, result in the Karcist suiciding itself cursing the land the community lives on.

Hook/Attention-Grabber: I want to use the common trope of the Curse of the Pharao as the attention grabber here, leaving the image of two embracing figures as the question during the description, that is then explained in the addenda.

Additional Notes: If you have any ideas how I can improve on simply explaining how the foundation keeps people from staying to long at the pyramids, so that the actual story is brought to the reader quicker, please let me know. The containment procedures in this SCP sadly do not provide as much ideas to help the pacing.


As a courtesy to our readers on mobile devices, please collapse long posts. ~Zyn

item.title: SCP Idea - Lost World
item.description: My idea for SCP and tale it tells.
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Genre (Optional): Emotional

Page Layout (Optional): Containment, Description, Exploration and Tale connected to it.

Elevator Pitch: Mansion in which pianist remains is placed 2 miles East in Allegheny National Forest. Anomalous pianist creates world and story of it's fall in his music. People that will hear his music hallucinate through it's whole story being able to hear and see everything, but not being able to interact with that world. People under influence will feel like the story continues for hours while in normal time it's only about 5 minutes long. After seeing it's whole story, influenced individuals show symptoms of extreme depression and inability to die of old age as they are "already dead inside".

Central Narrative: Everything occurs in mansion build 2 miles East in Allegheny National Forest. SCP Foundation got intel about this SCP, through many suicides happening lately in the forest. Previously mentioned anomalous pianist plays a song with length of 4 minutes and 56 seconds, but for influenced person it's like hours. Pianist shows them all tragedies of "lost world". Everyone who sees the story became extremely depressed and unable to talk about it to the point where influenced individuals commit suicide. People influenced by this SCP are empty. They are alive, but they barely eat, drink or sleep and a they do is look nowhere. People that saw the story are unable to die of old age as they are "already dead inside". Only one D-Class individual was able to keep part of his sanity and as ex writer, he was able to write just a portion of what he saw as a tale. D-Class few weeks after dies by stabbing his own throat with pen, he was given to write the rest of story.

item.title: Blood Storm
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: SCP Article

Genre (Optional):

Page Layout (Optional):

Elevator Pitch: A storm that appears once every 4 years in a completely random location on Earth. The rain is red and feels like blood and if touched with bare skin it will turn you into a mindless zombie with increased speed and strength. It is not possible to convert people back to normal.

Central Narrative: This SCP is usually the size of the state of Texas. It will appear on a random day after 4 years in a random location at a random time which makes it much harder to tell if the storm is abroad. The first hour of the storm will appear as just cloudy but after the hour is over, the rain will begin to pour. During the first hour, civilians in the range of the storm will be warned of the storm via EAS on television, radio, and cell phone. Anyone not taking cover will be detained by arriving MTF agents. Aggression towards MTF agents will be met with lethal force. The storm will usually last between 16 to 28 hours and once its over, all civilians in the area must be given amnestics to forget about the past hours of the storm. Anyone lost during the event must be given a cover story as to why they are gone.

Hook/Attention-Grabber: During the most recent event, a man created a journal explaining his experience of the storm and everything that happens while the MTF guard the streets to keep people safe.

Additional Notes: I would like suggestions of how to make this better if it isn't too good.

item.title: (SEEKING GREENLIGHT) This Number is no Longer in Service
item.description: A disconnected phone used by a desperate man
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: SCP Article

Genre: Drama/Emotional

Page Layout: I plan to use the traditional SCP format with an ACS header. The plot will reveal itself through the recovery log and a set of phone calls received by the object.

+ show block
– hide block

Elevator Pitch: In the 1968 the Foundation incepted a package from one of their mailrooms. The package contained a 1940’s rotary dial telephone that receives a phone call every day at 12:00 AM despite the cord being cut. The same phone call is repeated nightly until it is changed by the caller. The phone calls slowly reveal the story of a foundation researcher who has been captured by the Chaos Insurgency. He intended to send the phone to his family in hopes to ensure them that he is safe.

Central Narrative: The calls the man makes to his family slowly reveal a story. In the first call he will inform his family that “the guys at work” have a job for him and that he won’t be home for a little while. In the second phone call the man is less optimistic, however his tone is still hopeful and he attempts to ensure his wife that he will be home soon. He refers to his captures as “they”. In the final phone calls he refers to his captures as the Insurgency (Chaos Insurgency) and is mostly pessimistic in tone. In the final phone call, he apologizes to his family and is ill. These phone calls will take place over the course of 50 years.

An addendum at the end of the article will state that the foundation visited the home address that the man sent the package to. House was empty and it is implied that the family living there was killed by the Chaos Insurgency. This is meant to get an emotional response out of the reader. Not only were his calls not received by his family, but rather the foundation, but his family may not have been alive this entire time.

Hook/Attention-Grabber: This article will stand out because of its extremely simple concept that requires emotional investment. It is easy for any reader to understand (you do not even need to know what the Chaos Insurgency is to understand the basic premise). It is meant to be a refreshing break from the more complex articles on the site.

Additional Notes: The following information will be given during the article:
1. No phone calls can be made on the phone. It functions as a normal, disconnected phone when not receiving its nightly call.
2. The object is classified as neutralized, as it no longer makes calls.

item.title: The Knife (SEEKING GREENLIGHT)
item.description: An anomalous knife which surprisingly was contained by the Foundation.
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: SCP Article

Genre (Optional): Mystery

Elevator Pitch: It's a kitchen knife with coordinates on it leading to a small island which doesn't seem to have any anomalous activity. If anyone lays an eye on the knife, without a camera or artist depiction, they will hear whispers of voices telling them to 'become one with him'. The Foundation currently does not know what this phrase means. Anyways, the victim will have an urge to equip the knife to once again 'become one with him'. The victim will chant 'I must become one with him' and once said victim holds up the knife, the victim is now considered a 'host'. The host will be controlled by some unknown entity and is severely hostile to humans. After host manages to catch an unfortunate being, it will ingest the victim before falling dead and the knife will dematerialize and then materialize in a random location. Witnesses who manage to get a glimpse of the host will suddenly suffer cardiac arrest due to unknown means. Cameras or artist depictions do not trigger the knife's affects.

Central Narrative: Several reports came through on an evening saying that multiple civilians have mysteriously gone 'insane' and a another bunch have somehow created a cult around a specific kitchen knife worshipping it. Then other reports came in reporting that multiple civilians in a town began acting strange and soon enough the entire town was in anarchy. Eventually, the Foundation found out about this strange event and so 'invaded' the town, securing it and the knife with the loss of 7 agents in the process. The remaining agents all suddenly chanted 'This world will fall into anarchy' after the mission.

Hook/Attention-Grabber: It includes a mysterious 'him' which could make the reader figure out who this 'him' was and why the cult was created along with why the chanting occurs.

Additional Notes: First attempt at making my own SCP sooo.. yeah it probably won't be that good but eh
